units: <cite ref="Yevamot 101a:3">Yeb. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>נאמר … שאין בה ש׳ וכ׳</he> cursing is mentioned with reference to those below (parents, <cite ref="Exodus 21:17">Ex. XXI, 17</cite>), and with reference to Him above (<cite ref="Leviticus 24:15">Lev. XXIV, 15</cite>): as there is no association above, so must there be no association below (i.e. the curse to be punishable must refer to each singly).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:8">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אסור לאדם שיעשה ש׳ וכ׳</he> one must not form a partnership with an idolater, lest he may have to swear, and he would swear by his idol &c.; <cite ref="Bekhorot 2b:19">Bekh. 2ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:11">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>למיעבד ש׳ בהדיה</he> to go into partnership with him (on whom ‘the hour smiles’).
<cite ref="Eruvin 71b:5">Erub. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>שלקחו … בש׳</he> when they bought a cask of wine in partnership.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 9:3">Tosef. Keth. IX, 3</cite> <he>כל זמן ששותף יוצא משׁוּתָּפוּתוֹ</he> (not <he>משותפתו</he>) as soon as the partner goes out of his partnership.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:8:7">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵇ</cite> top; a. e.
